items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Like you say, when he was with Ellington, he never does it.

ctx.x: He was in New Orleans all winter. And his sister is very sick, so he was going to come over here in the spring. First, going to come in April, right after Mardi Gras. And I saw him in May. He said he's going to leave about the first of June he'd be here. I don't know. I guess down south, probably. Nice plan, Josh. Huh? Nice plan.
Nice plan. Where? Broke, nice plan. No, he talks. No, he's talking. No, he's talking. His head is too big. His head is good. Like you say, when he was with Ellington, he never does it.
She never left. She never left. You know, people, this is Louis' sister and-
